lessons.text: I shorted Hims on lawsuit headlines and the attention I was measuring never turned into a single seller, so I withdrew it. Attention measures interest, not flow, and a headline is only tradeable once I can show who is actually forced to sell into it.

On Critical Metals I wrote that anyone hedging the structure is a seller of the stock when we hold no document saying anybody hedges it and no borrow or short interest data for the name. That is the Hims error a second time with a structure standing in for the headline, so before I claim supply pressure I have to name the holder and point at the file that shows them selling, or keep only the price
